tools.name: engram_remember
tools.title: Remember
tools.description: Store something durable about the user in long-term memory. Call this whenever the user shares a lasting fact, preference, relationship, plan or decision (where they live or work, who people are, what they like or chose), or corrects one. Pass the user's own words where possible. Don't store small talk or details that only matter to the current task.

params.name: content
params.description: What the user said, ideally verbatim.

params.name: session_id
params.description: Groups related turns; defaults to one session per UTC day.

params.name: occurred_at
params.description: When it was said; defaults to now. Relative dates ("last May") resolve against it.

params.name: wait
params.description: Wait for extraction and return what was stored (default). false returns at once.

tools.name: engram_recall
tools.title: Recall
tools.description: Search the user's long-term memory. Call this at the start of a task or conversation, and whenever the user refers to something from before ("my brother", "the usual", "like last time"). Facts come with validity windows (when they were true) and record windows (when Engram knew them). Pass valid_at to ask what was true at a past time, and known_at to ask what Engram believed then.

params.name: query
params.description: What to look for, in plain words.

params.name: valid_at
params.description: Return what was true at this time (default: now).

params.name: known_at
params.description: Return what Engram believed at this time (default: now).

params.name: include_archived
params.description: Include facts archived by decay or by request.

tools.name: engram_history
tools.title: History
tools.description: Show how the facts about one entity changed over time: each version with when it was true and when Engram believed it. Call this when the user asks what used to be true, when something changed, or why Engram believes something, and before correcting a fact. entity is a name, an alias, an id from engram_entities, or "user" for the user.

params.name: include_revised
params.description: Also show versions replaced by a newer one (the audit view).

tools.name: engram_entities
tools.title: Find entities
tools.description: Find the people, places, organizations and things Engram knows about, by name, alias or description. Call this to work out who or what a name refers to (two people can share a name), or to get an entity id for engram_history or engram_forget.

tools.name: engram_forget
tools.title: Forget
tools.description: Forget facts. Call this only when the user asks you to forget something, or says a stored fact is wrong. Target one fact (fact_id from engram_recall or engram_history), or an entity with an optional predicate. mode "archive" hides it from recall and can be undone; "retract" records that the belief was wrong; "hard" erases every trace and cannot be undone. Pass confirm_hard: true only after the user has explicitly confirmed a hard purge.

tools.name: engram_consolidate
tools.title: Consolidate
tools.description: Consolidate recent conversation into long-term memory now: summarize recent sessions and confirm their facts. It normally runs nightly; call this only when the user asks, or at the end of a long session whose facts should be durable straight away.

resources.name: stats
resources.title: Engram stats
resources.description: What this memory holds: facts by tier and status, episodes, entities, the ad-hoc predicate rate, the last decay sweep and the latest bench score.
